name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted Instant realtime backend with its dashboard, PostgreSQL database and S3-compatible file storage for auth, permissions, storage and presence.

alerts.message: Until POSTMARK_TOKEN, SENDGRID_TOKEN or RESEND_TOKEN is set, dashboard login codes are only printed in the instantdb-server logs. By default anyone can sign up to the dashboard and anyone who reaches the API can create temporary apps: set INSTANT_SUPERUSER_EMAIL to your address, then use Deployment Settings to restrict signups and turn off temporary apps.
The dashboard runs on the main domain and the backend API on the api. subdomain. Point your apps and the Instant CLI (INSTANT_CLI_API_URI, INSTANT_CLI_DASH_URI) at those two URLs.
